rows.text: INT4 weights are half the size of standard INT8 weights, allowing significantly more data to fit within the same memory capacity. This reduction in weight size directly decreases the total volume of data that must be transferred from memory to the processor during inference. Consequently, the system spends less time waiting for data, thereby lowering memory bandwidth
